gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-osage: Flavors is whimsical and bossy, with diagonals as hefty as its stems and a towering lowercase. Noto Sans Osage is the quieter half, its bowls inflated to fill the line and its curves left sweeping open.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Chunky, playful, and impossible to ignore. Flavors holds one laser-etched line weight from end to end, while Noto Sans Osmanya lets its oversized lowercase and wide-turning s shapes settle in underneath.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Flavors is built from diagonals as heavy as its stems, topped by a lowercase that towers like a stubby pencil. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong has the opposite temperament, with a high-set x-height and rounds that gap open like a cracked bangle.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Cut-out strokes, like a router bit tracing a fixed width, give Flavors its whimsical bite. Noto Sans Palmyrene feels lighter beside it, its curves stopping short and its ascenders compressed into something tidy and modern.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Almendra Display is ornate and bookish, with a pronounced x-height and letters that refuse to pinch shut. Noto Sans Rejang follows with wide, porthole-like counters, though shrinking the heading would blunt the first one's flourish.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa keeps its c openings clear and its capitals gently raised. Audiowide goes futuristic with tile-like glyphs and no heavy-to-light shift in any stroke, while the body simply stays friendly and readable.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Flavors is loud, whimsical, and stroke-for-stroke uniform. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau gives it somewhere to rest, with open-ended curves and capitals only a short step above the lowercase, so the heading's swagger stands out.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-samari: Noto Sans Samaritan brings hefty lowercase and curves full of daylight, friendly on the eye. And Almendra Display sits above it with ornate, literary letters, so a long passage would read smoothly after that opening flourish.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-runic: Stroke ends cut as if from one ribbon give Audiowide its futuristic, tile-set look. And Noto Sans Runic does the quiet work, with a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra barely lifts its capitals above the lowercase. Eater is the dark, aggressive one, with sturdy joins that slim and wide gaps between letters, while the body keeps its counters open to the outside.
